sentences.english: The boy has a small horse.
The boy gives food to the horse.
The boy leads the horse to the road.
The boy loves the faithful horse.
The queen has a wise poet.
The poet gives the queen a beautiful song.
The queen hears the new song.

sentences.latin: Itaque rēgīna poētae dōnum magnum dat.
sentences.english: And so the queen gives the poet a great gift.

sentences.latin: Poēta fidēlis ā rēgīnā sapientī laudātur.
sentences.english: The faithful poet is praised by the wise queen.

sentences.latin: Dux fortis mīlitēs suōs ad vallum altum dūcit.
sentences.english: The brave general leads his own soldiers to the high rampart.

sentences.latin: Mīlitēs fortēs vallum altum lapidibus magnīs mūniunt.
sentences.english: The brave soldiers fortify the high rampart with large stones.
But the fierce enemies attack the rampart.

sentences.latin: Dux mīlitibus fortibus scūta magna dat.
sentences.english: The general gives large shields to the brave soldiers.

sentences.latin: Itaque vallum ā mīlitibus fortibus custōdītur.
sentences.english: And so the rampart is guarded by the brave soldiers.
